databaseName: Section 5 - SageMaker: Which algorithms support each input format?

questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Linear Learner (Float32 only), XGBoost, Seq2Seq (integer tokens), Object Detection (MXNet), Image Classification, Random Cut Forest (RCF), Neural Topic Model (NTM), LDA (Latent Dirichlet Allocation), KNN, K-Means, PCA (Principal Component Analysis), Factorization Machines (Float32 only; CSV not available).

Linear Learner, XGBoost, LightGBM (text/CSV only), Random Cut Forest (RCF), Neural Topic Model (NTM), LDA (Latent Dirichlet Allocation), KNN, K-Means, PCA (Principal Component Analysis), IP Insights (CSV only).
XGBoost (AWS extended; required for distributed GPU in 1.5), DeepAR (jsonl can be gzip or parquet).
DeepAR (each record: start, target; optional dynamic_feat, cat; can be gzip or parquet).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: Which algorithms support `text` (one sentence per line) or `augmented manifest` (text)?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: BlazingText (text classification: __Label__ then label, one sentence per line; also augmented manifest text format; Word2Vec: text file with one training sentence per line).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: Which algorithms support `image` format (e.g. jpg, png)?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Object Detection (MXNet; RecordIO or image jpg/png with JSON annotations), Image Classification (RecordIO or image format), Semantic Segmentation (jpg or png with annotations and label maps).

questionsWithAnswers.questionText: Which algorithms support tokenized `JSON` (pairs or sequences of tokens)?
questionsWithAnswers.answerText: Object2Vec (training data: pairs and/or sequences of tokens, e.g. JSON with label, in0, in1; data must be tokenized into integers).
